title: A grievance from Perak
body: Awang Musa’s nakhoda comes ashore angry. His tin sat a whole tide under guard, and the court’s men found nothing but a factor who wrote the wrong unit. The Perak boats are small and run on thin margins; he says some will try the Pasai market instead if Melaka holds them for a clerk’s mistake.

choices.label: Promise his next boat an early berth
choices.outcome_text: You promise the Arus’s next voyage a berth on arrival. The nakhoda leaves calmer, and the tin keeps coming down the coast.

choices.label: Tell him to fix his factor’s papers
choices.outcome_text: You tell him a correct declaration would have saved the tide. He does not argue, but you hear later that two Perak boats turned north for Pasai.
